instruction: I'm having trouble with Chrome's color scheme - could you assist me in disabling the automatic dark mode that activates based on my system's time settings? I prefer to keep the browser in light mode at all times regardless of the time of day.

metadata.explanation: Task variation focuses on disabling Chrome's automatic dark mode scheduling. Marked as infeasible because automatic theme switching based on system time cannot be reliably automated and verified in the OSWorld environment.
